image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vertical traffic light. The middle amber/yellow lens is illuminated, casting a warm glow on the textured internal reflector and the visor above it. The top red lens is unlit but visible, showing its honeycomb texture. The bottom green lens is obscured by shadow and the angle. The housing is black with distinct circular hoods (visors) over each light. A mounting arm is visible in the background against a blurred building facade.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class identity and rule out misclassification as similar industrial lights.
To inspect the texture of the lit lens and the sharpness of the visor edges for any AI-generated smearing or unnatural glow.
To verify the physical connection between the light housing and the mounting arm, ensuring no floating elements or depth bleeding.
To ensure the circular hoods have clean, continuous boundaries without melting into the housing or background.

focus_areas: Texture consistency of the illuminated amber lens (honeycomb pattern)
Sharpness and geometric correctness of the visor hoods
Physical plausibility of the mounting bracket connection
Lighting coherence (glow from amber light affecting surrounding housing)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the internal texture of the lit amber lens. AI generators often struggle with the complex faceted reflector patterns inside traffic lights, sometimes producing smooth gradients instead of sharp geometric textures. Also, verify that the shadow cast by the visor onto the lens is physically consistent with the light source direction.
